# prime-toggleswitch

prime-rs: ToggleSwitch component (port of PrimeNG)

[Live demo](https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/toggleswitch) · [API docs](https://docs.rs/prime-toggleswitch) · [Port notes](https://github.com/anton-avramchuk/prime-rs/blob/HEAD/docs/toggleswitch.md)

ToggleSwitch — port of `p-toggleswitch` from PrimeNG 21.1.10.

Markup and classes as in PrimeNG: root `div.p-toggleswitch` (instead of the host `<p-toggleswitch>`) with `style="position: relative"`,
inside `input.p-toggleswitch-input[role=switch]` and `div.p-toggleswitch-slider` with `div.p-toggleswitch-handle`.

The state is a two-way signal `checked: RwSignal<bool>`; a click on any part of the root toggles it and calls `on_change`.
Without `checked` the switch is uncontrolled: the initial state comes from `default_checked`, after that the DOM keeps it, and the root classes
are not tracked.

```rust
use leptos::prelude::*;
use prime_toggleswitch::ToggleSwitch;

let checked = RwSignal::new(true);
let html = view! { <ToggleSwitch checked=checked name="notify" /> }.to_html();
assert!(html.contains("p-toggleswitch-checked") && html.contains("p-toggleswitch-slider") && html.contains(r#"name="notify""#));
```

## Installation

```toml
[dependencies]
prime-toggleswitch = "0.1"
prime-theme = { version = "0.1", features = ["toggleswitch"] }
```

The component renders PrimeNG classes; its styles come from `prime-theme` (the Aura theme), one feature per component.
For server rendering enable the `ssr` feature in the server build and `hydrate` in the browser build.
Setting up an application (theme, SSR and hydration): https://anton-avramchuk.github.io/prime-rs/install
